summary: The bounded constructor-only java/util/TreeMap amendment satisfies the stated acceptance criteria. The final MC-TREE-MAP-P2 source delta is narrow and internally cross-pinned; the supplied 132-byte major-52 class is exactly a public Object subclass with one no-arg constructor; generated construction, omission, boundary, retained-control, reopen, and canonical-receipt coverage is appropriate. The authoritative machine result records the final P2 gate pass and the original30 atomic ProviderUtil missing-class frontier without broader claims.

Its SHA-256 is c203bc1cf3e4f7d9901b49f0415e10e0aa6331eb99c366e24f68b6fc2a60e067 and it exactly matches the embedded bootstrap image and supplied source claim. The generated probe checks two distinct non-null allocations and stable alias identity across q1/q7/direct/reopen.

The image has no Map-family interface or operation surface. Separate generated paths require TreeMap.put to refuse with CallError(3,13) and explicit SortedMap use to refuse with a canonical missing-class diagnostic. Claims explicitly exclude providers, world, and Done.

The gate runs construction at quanta 1, 7, and 4096, verifies reopen state, checks uninitialized and raw-replacement behavior, retains String/lastIndexOf/StringBuilder/System.err/failed-initialization/raw count and byte boundaries/EnumSet/queue/OOM controls, and canonically re-encodes successful receipts. The authoritative result reports 71 worlds and 2606 canonical receipts for the candidate and the same 2606-receipt pass for final P2.

Final P2 engine/coordinator addresses and hashes agree across the engine/coordinator/driver deltas, parent pins, and authoritative machine result. Compiler settings remain optimizer 200, viaIR, Cancun, metadata-off. Original30 is limited to 12005 Java/40 internal steps, lifecycle 1, 1715 canonical receipts, then atomic ProviderUtil missing-class refusal; no provider/world/Done result is claimed.

findings.title: Archived helper scripts retain the candidate P1 identity rather than the final parent P2 identity
findings.detail: tools/build.py, tools/verify_source.py, and the gate summary identify MC-TREE-MAP-P1/P1 addresses, while the reviewed final amendment is MC-TREE-MAP-P2. machine-result.json explicitly distinguishes the candidate build/gate from the authoritative final parent build/gate, and all final diffs/pins cross-match, so this is not a semantic or acceptance blocker. It is a traceability/standalone-reproduction sharp edge: the supplied helper scripts should not be mistaken for a direct P2 rebuild recipe.
